english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a bicycle in everyday Hong Kong speech.
This is the all-purpose choice when the bike is pedal-powered, especially a bicycle.
This is the all-purpose everyday choice for the pedal-powered vehicle sense of “cycle.”

examples.english: I often bicycle to the beach on weekends.
examples.traditional: 我週末成日踩單車去海邊。
